in_marathi.name: Jalaja
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lotus born in water
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jalaja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jalaja is a beautiful Sanskrit name, derived from the word Jala, which means water. This name symbolizes a lotus flower born in water, representing purity, strength, and the ability to rise above challenges. According to Hindu mythology, the lotus flower is a symbol of enlightenment, detachment, and beauty. The name Jalaja is considered auspicious and is often given to girls in Hindu traditions.

vedic_reference.note: Name of a goddess in Hindu mythology, Jalaja is a form of the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, music, arts, wisdom, and learning. She is also known as Vadavali, Vagdevi, and Sita. Jalaja is an embodiment of the creative, nurturing, and protective aspects of water.
